title: How Russia-linked crypto exchanges, like Bitpapa, Exmo, and others help Russian entities move money across borders, bypassing banking oversight and sanctions (Elliptic)
summary: Elliptic: How Russia-linked crypto exchanges, like Bitpapa, Exmo, and others help Russian entities move money across borders, bypassing banking oversight and sanctions — Cryptoasset exchanges that maintain operational or financial connections with Russia continue to enable the circumvention of international sanctions.
